title: Arturia Mini V4 reference suite for the Mono (voice) family
parent_ruling: #1048 (voice-only silicon target, 2026-11-18): the commercial reference for the voice becomes Mini V4, baselined as a new, separate suite.

plugin.name: Mini V4
plugin.fleet_note: Mini V4 ships only for macOS/Windows, so no fleet worker can render it. Renders happen on an operator Mac in an attended session; nothing here attempts one.

host.planned: dawdreamer (the rig layer's primary host; the V3 records were captured under dawdreamer 0.8.3)
host.state: unverified for Mini V4 -- which host loads and sounds a plugin is data, measured at the first attended session (docs/pedalboard-rig.md). The render script refuses until it has qualified the rig it actually found.
host.block_note: 16 samples, as the frozen V3 captures used: parameter automation lands once per host block, so a 512-sample block moves a swept control at 93.75 Hz and manufactures ripple that is the harness's, not the plugin's.

state: no renders yet -- every case below is awaiting its render
comparison_rule: A V4 render is never graded against a V3 expectation, and a V3 record is never graded against a V4 expectation. tools/reference_suites.py refuses the mix at the scoring boundary. V3 records are frozen: not regenerated, not edited (docs/scorecard/reference-suite-freeze.sha256).

render.phrase_s_note: The plan states a dry 4-8 s phrase plus complete release for the standard cases; 8.0 s is the top of that stated range so the complete release fits inside the render. Cases whose own spec states a different length carry it.
render.normalisation: none -- raw float at the plugin's own gain, as the frozen V3 records are
preconditions: the operator states how the licence position was established (refuse if unstated; an unlicensed Arturia plugin inserts artefacts, as Diva's demo did)
pitch readback: a calibration note must sound within 50 cents of the commanded pitch (Mini V3's Range default was an octave down; assert what defaults wrongly, every time)
the render is not exact silence (a host that returns no signal answers no question)
